title: Kamek Sayang Kitak
subject: At the Kuching Waterfront over two glasses of teh C peng, a Sarawakian woman tells her Kedah boyfriend 'kamek sayang kitak'; he hears 'kami sayang kita', asks who 'we' are, and once she translates answers in his own dialect: 'aku sayang hang'.
caption: Malay Eurodance, 1990s club dance-pop with a sung hook. A punchy four-on-the-floor kick with an offbeat synth bass pumping under it, bright Italo-style piano stabs on the upbeats, a sharp saw-synth lead playing the hook, and a string-pad riser into each chorus. Glossy 90s club mix, kick and lead forward, wide pads, short plate reverb. Female bright mezzo lead with a playful edge, a small mixed group answering the hook on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 138 BPM, F# minor. Flirty, teasing and dance-floor bright. No rap verse, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no disco strings, no slap bass, no rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - synth pad, kick enters, piano stabs]
[Verse 1]
Waterfront Kuching, angin petang
Teh C peng dua gelas atas meja
Aku renung dia, aku bisik
Kamek sayang kitak, abang
[Pre-Chorus]
Dia berkerut, dia garu kepala
Kami? Kita? Siapa kami?
[Chorus]
Kamek sayang kitak, kitak sayang kamek
Tak faham pun tak apa, tak apa
Kamek sayang kitak, kitak sayang kamek
Menari dulu, terjemah kemudian
[Verse 2]
Aku terang pelan-pelan
Kamek itu aku, kitak itu awak
Dia senyum lebar, dia angguk
Dia tarik nafas, dia buka mulut
[Pre-Chorus]
Dia ketuk meja, dia ketawa
Dengar baik-baik, dengar sini
[Chorus]
Kamek sayang kitak, aku sayang hang
Dua loghat, satu lagu, satu hati
Kamek sayang kitak, aku sayang hang
Menari dulu, terjemah kemudian
[Bridge - piano stabs only, then kick returns]
Ais dah cair, teh pun dah tawar
[Chorus]
Kamek sayang kitak, aku sayang hang
Sarawak Kedah, jumpa di tengah
Kamek sayang kitak, aku sayang hang
Menari dulu, terjemah kemudian
[Outro - lead synth, kick fades]
Kamek, kitak, aku, hang
